svg.title: Smart Warehouse Planner — Components sheet 1, alternative A: Spec sheet
svg.desc: Spec sheet of the Key colour popover with numbered parts, measurements and its checks; Key entry states; toast anatomy and variants; Apply all confirm popover and Delete plan dialog; read-only Settings with class limits drawn as a ruler; buttons and the fixed focus ring. Real size, synthetic data.
svg.text: Key colour popover, read-only Settings, toasts, confirm popover and dialog, and the buttons they use.
Drawn at real size. Numbered pins name the parts; red-brown lines give sizes in CSS px.
DESIGN.md and EXPERIENCE.md win on conflict
FR-42 · the only place a colour changes
The Key sits under every wall. Six entries are buttons; Empty and 2 parts are plain text.
